title: Integrate finding registry with shared bootstrap capability identity
description: After the bootstrap capability-ledger contract lands, replace the temporary local CapabilityIdentity, hook selector, canonical primitive roster, and capability-catalog serialization boundary in findingRegistry.ts with the shared stable types. Preserve engine:F1..F10 spellings, exact clause-hook membership, historical family-epic ownership validation, and the registry compatibility tests; do not import across an unfinished branch.
